282269493.description:
Art Glass Cullet Chunk
Cobalt Blue with Rainbow Iridescent Finish
Decorative Glass Specimen, 1.365 Pounds
Substantial decorative chunk of cobalt blue cullet slag glass displaying a vibrant iridescent carnival-style flash across fractured planes and smooth surfaces. Raw glass chunks like this were produced during the glassmaking process at heritage American glassworks, where excess furnace glass cooled into monolithic blocks before being fractured into decorative specimens prized for garden displays, lapidary projects, and paperweights.
Intense translucent cobalt blue glass body with rich color depth
Exterior exhibits strong rainbow iridescence in vivid hues of gold, magenta, and turquoise
Natural conchoidal fracturing showcasing glass cleavage, smooth waves, and raw crystalline textures
Measures approximately 4 inches by 2.25 inches by 3.25 inches; weighs 1.365 pounds
Condition:
Formed as a raw fractured glass chunk with natural sharp edges, conchoidal ridges, and cleavage faces inherent to slag glass. Clean surfaces with brilliant luster and no post-manufacture cloudiness or chemical damage.
